scripts.start: pnpm run foliate:web-runtime:sync && pnpm run foliate:web-runtime:check && expo start
scripts.web: pnpm run foliate:web-runtime:sync && pnpm run foliate:web-runtime:check && expo start --web
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run foliate:web-runtime:sync && pnpm run foliate:web-runtime:check && expo start --web --lan --no-open
